follow-on: test_the_module_is_the_one_under_test asserts only `profile_module.__file__ is not None`, which cannot detect the stale installed copy its docstring names, because a stale copy imported from site-packages also has a non-None __file__; the assertion passes whether or not the module under test is the one just written, so it guards nothing.

follow-on: a size bucket's `runs` is len of the per-bucket wall list, so it counts only rows that carry a wall_seconds, while the parallel group table's `runs` at line 235 counts every member; the two tables' `runs` therefore mean different things, and a backend whose rows all lack a wall_seconds never reaches per_backend at line 267 and is dropped from size_buckets entirely even though it appears in groups.
